title: High-Nuclearity Ce/Mn and Th/Mn Cluster Chemistry: Preparation of Complexes with [Ce4Mn10O10(OMe)6]18+ and [Th6Mn10O22(OH)2]18+ Cores

synthesis.procedure: Aerobic Method A: a MeCN solution of (NBu^n4)[Mn4O2(O2CPh)9(H2O)] (3) was treated with solid (NBu^n4)2Ce(NO3)6 and stirred 20 min. The brown solution was filtered to remove an off-white precipitate, and the filtrate was layered with MeOH and left at room temperature. After ~2 weeks, reddish-brown crystals of 1·H2O·4MeOH·6MeCN were collected, washed with Et2O, and dried in vacuo (dried solid analyzed as 1·4H2O). Method B: treating [Mn3O(O2CPh)6(py)2(H2O)] (4) in MeCN with (NBu^n4)2Ce(NO3)6, then the same workup, also gave 1·4H2O.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic solution reaction, filtration, MeOH layering
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filter off-white precipitate; layer filtrate with MeOH (10 mL); collect X-ray-quality reddish-brown crystals of 1·H2O·4MeOH·6MeCN, wash with Et2O, dry in vacuo (analyzed as 1·4H2O)

properties.summary: Dried 1·4H2O is a mixed-valence CeIII2CeIV2MnIII10 cluster with dominant antiferromagnetic exchange and an approximate S = 4 ground state. χMT falls from 34.38 cm3 mol−1 K (300 K) to 10.26 cm3 mol−1 K (5.0 K). Magnetization fitting (0.1–3.0 T, 1.8–10 K) gave S = 4, D = −0.57(2) cm−1, g = 2.09(1). Frequency-dependent ac χM″ tails appear below 3 K for both wet 1·H2O·4MeOH·6MeCN and dried 1·4H2O, but micro-SQUID M vs H scans to 0.04 K show only tiny hysteresis assigned to intermolecular H-bonding rather than SMM blocking; the compound is concluded not to be an SMM.
